en.headline: Chan Kwok-ki inspects Huanggang Port, demands highest standards for drills
en.dek: The Chief Secretary visited the Hong Kong-side facilities on Thursday afternoon and said the inter-departmental team must complete more than 100 exercises and tests to the highest standard before the redeveloped checkpoint opens.
body: Chief Secretary for Administration Chan Kwok-ki inspected the Hong Kong-side facilities at the redeveloped Huanggang Port on Thursday afternoon and emphasised that every drill and test must meet the highest standard.

In a social-media post, Mr Chan said he examined passenger and vehicle clearance routes, the joint one-stop vehicle lanes, cooperative self-service channels and the public-transport interchange, and received a progress briefing from the inter-departmental working group.

He said the group was preparing more than 100 exercises and tests across about 20 categories, following a phased, progressive approach modelled on the successful preparations for Kai Tak Sports Park. Only after all tests confirm safe and orderly operations will the governments of Hong Kong and Guangdong decide the opening date.

zh.headline: 陳國基視察皇崗口岸 要求演練達最高標準
zh.dek: 政務司司長周四下午到港方口岸區實地視察，強調跨部門小組必須以最高標準完成逾百項演練及測試，確保通關安全暢順後才正式開通。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周四下午到重建後的皇崗口岸港方口岸區視察，強調所有演練及測試必須達到最高標準。
陳國基在社交平台表示，他實地了解聯檢大樓通關走線、設施布局、旅檢樓層旅客通道、港方公共運輸交匯處接駁安排，並巡視「聯合一站式」車道及旅客「合作查驗」自助通道，聽取跨部門小組匯報最新測試進度及人員部署。
他指小組正籌備涵蓋約20個類別、超過100個不同規模的演練和測試，借鑑啟德體育園開幕前經驗，以分階段推進、逐步加壓、持續優化為主軸。完成全部測試並確認運作就緒後，粵港兩地政府才會敲定正式開通日期。
